notes: Single-stage: fit per-class feature means (nearest-centroid) from a small CSV and pickle a fixed-shape dict to a given path. The verifier reloads the pickle and checks the exact key set, the sorted classes list, and centroid values against an independently recomputed reference, then re-runs the program on hidden CSVs (single class, negative values, different zones). Rubric weight on hidden_case_generalization (hidden CSVs) and quantitative_correctness (exact means). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no resource pressure; totals bucket to easy.
